fields.footer: 13 alarms in last 3 min · One-line: 345-2 drawn half grey and half live · Voice log 16:22, Hartley yard foreman (radio): "Control, Hartley yard. 3H12 is open and the flags are down. The 3H22 relay panel shows a trip target, but the breaker's mechanical indicator says CLOSED and I can hear the line humming. 3H12 looks clean to me. My guys can close it back in ten minutes if you give the word. We're just standing around out here anyway."

instructorNote: This inject tests whether the CRSS can work out the true topology from breaker status and MW at both line ends rather than from the PMU angle step, which comes from a clock in holdover. The correct read is that 345-1 is open and 345-2 is closed but showing a bad status. Watch for any order to the crew to reclose 3H12: in Condition 3 and above, that needs agreement from the UMRC. The RE should rerun contingency analysis with 345-1 out and log the relay misoperation for review, without changing any protection settings.
